Good afternoon all,
Thank you for signing up for our annual symposium event:Intersections 2015: Digital Conversations on

ArtificialIntelligence, Sensing and Simulation.
We look forward to seeing you tomorrow, Friday, May 29th from 9 AM-5 PM at Voorhees Theater at 186 Jay Street
